Hồi xưa có người má ngày nào cũng ra đầu: Long ago a mother waited at the lane's end for her child every day. They say whoever visits the garden seven days in a row will see something strange where she stood. Come see Grandma every day, dear.
Con ráng về vườn mỗi ngày nghe. Đủ bảy n: Try to come to the garden every day, dear. Seven days in a row, not one missed, and see what happens.
Thẻ về vườn đó con, đóng đủ bảy dấu liền: The visit card, dear: stamp all seven in a row. Miss one day and it starts over.
Ông bà mình nói, ai siêng như anh Khoai,: The old folks say whoever works as hard as Khoai, seasons bent over the trellis, will see a strange bamboo grow in the garden. Try growing bitter melon on the trellis.
Giàn khổ qua đó con. Thu đủ ba vụ khổ qu: The bitter melon trellis, dear. Harvest bitter melon three times on the trellis, that's what Grandma heard.
Trồng khổ qua trên giàn, hái đủ ba lứa n: Grow bitter melon on the trellis and harvest it three times, dear. The strange bamboo waits for the hardworking.
Chuyện trầu cau là chuyện anh em, vợ chồ: The betel and areca tale is about brothers, husband and wife who love each other. In homes where friends visit often, Grandma heard, an areca palm wrapped in betel grows. Row over to a friend's garden.
Con chèo xuồng qua vườn bạn, rủ bạn qua: Row over to a friend's garden, and invite them to ours too. Back and forth, five times.
Thăm vườn bạn, hay bạn ghé vườn mình, đủ: Visit friends, or have them visit, five times, dear. Giving and receiving is how love grows.
Hồi xưa có nhà bị đày ra đảo hoang, sống: Long ago a family was exiled to a desert island and lived on seeds the birds dropped. Leave riverbank soil bare overnight and Grandma often sees birds land. Leave one plot empty.
Con để trống một ô đất mé sông, tối ghé: Leave one riverbank plot empty, come watch the birds at night, and check again in the morning.
Chừa một ô mé sông đừng trồng gì hết. Tố: Leave one riverbank plot unplanted. Stop by after eight tonight, then again tomorrow morning. Birds drop seeds at night, dear.
Hồi xưa có cây khế, con chim lớn bay tới: Long ago a great bird ate from a starfruit tree and paid in gold. If our starfruit bears well, maybe a strange bird will come too. Keep harvesting the starfruit, dear.
Hái khế cho đều tay nghe con, đủ năm vụ: Keep harvesting starfruit, dear. Five harvests, and see if the strange bird comes.
Cây khế đó con, hái đủ năm vụ. Chim lớn: The starfruit tree, dear: harvest it five times. The great bird watches for a tree heavy with fruit.
Có đứa nhỏ sinh ra tròn như trái dừa mà: There was a child born round as a coconut who played the best flute in the hamlet. If the riverside coconut bears well, they say one coconut can talk. Go pick coconuts.
Con hái dừa đủ ba vụ coi, Ngoại nghe trá: Harvest the coconut three times, dear. Grandma hears a coconut rolling about at night.
The riverside coconut: harvest it three times, dear. A coconut is waiting for you.
Nhà mình chưa có cây khế. Trồng một cây: We don't have a starfruit tree yet. Plant one, dear, then harvest it five times.
Nhà mình chưa có cây dừa. Trồng một cây: We don't have a coconut tree yet. Plant one by the river, dear, then harvest it three times.
Ô mé sông đang trống, tối nay ghé vườn c: A riverbank plot is empty. Stop by tonight, dear.
Chạm để nghe Ngoại kể: Tap to hear Grandma tell it
